inspection_summary.note: Texas HHSC inspections, report investigations and assessments since October 2017, updated daily.

occurrences.finding: Responsibilities - Not interfere with an inspection or investigation: During the inspection, the primary caregiver did not provide access to a bedroom in the home because the room was locked. A child was later observed exiting that room, where two individuals were present who did not have a background check.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Responsibilities - Not interfere with an inspection or investigation (26 TAC §745.8411(a))

occurrences.finding: AP Initial background checks submitted - At the time a non-client resident 14 or older moves into your home or operation: Two individuals were present in the home without  completed background checks.
occurrences.violation_type_title: AP Initial background checks submitted - At the time a non-client resident 14 or older moves into your home or operation (26 TAC §745.621(a)(5))

occurrences.finding: Electric or Battery Operated CO System-Test Monthly: Operation did not have a carbon monoxide checklist for CCR to view.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Electric or Battery Operated CO System-Test Monthly (26 TAC §747.5337(a)(2))

occurrences.finding: Smoke Detectors Testing: Documentation of monthly smoke detector testing was not available for review at the time of the inspection.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Smoke Detectors Testing (26 TAC §747.5115)

occurrences.finding: AP Background check determination - If ineligible then you must immediately remove subject from operation and confirm to CBCU receipt of notice letter: Household members living in the home and have been observed present with children in care on multiple occasions and the operation received ineligibility letters on both individuals.
occurrences.violation_type_title: AP Background check determination - If ineligible then you must immediately remove subject from operation and confirm to CBCU receipt of notice letter (26 TAC §745.635(2))
